title: Wild West Pub Crawl
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Get ready to drink like a legend on our Wild West Pub Crawl in Golden, CO! Embark on a lively afternoon through the town’s best saloons, guided by a costumed storyteller who’ll regale you with rowdy tales of outlaws, miners, and saloon shootouts. Sip on local craft brews and cocktails as you soak up the Wild West vibes in authentic historic bars. With fascinating stories, great drinks, and plenty of laughs, this 3-hour crawl is the perfect way to experience Golden’s gold rush roots. And don’t forget your complimentary golden bandana—a souvenir for the brave souls who join the ride!

Please visit our website for additional details, discounts, and availability!
